document.title: Ask AI buttons open the prompt in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or T3 Code
document.summary: Each Ask AI button gets a menu that picks Copy prompt, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or T3 Code, and opens a deep link for the picked app. `serve` now sends the work tree path as `repo.root`; an export sets it to null.
document.why: The user wants the Ask AI buttons to [put the prompt directly into an agent chat box without sending it](source:s2).

sources.title: Ask AI buttons open the prompt in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or T3 Code
sources.gist: A picker on every Ask AI button opens a draft prompt in the picked app by deep link.

sources.label: T3 Code session · Nov 1
sources.gist: Máté asks for a target picker on all AI buttons, then for one Claude Code option that opens the desktop app, and for the work tree folder in local reviews only.

lookFor: Claude Code's `folder` and Codex's `path` are not documented: [PR #172](source:s1) says they come from the apps' own code.

groups.title: Work tree path in the review payload
groups.why: Claude Code and Codex can open in the reviewed folder under `serve`, and [hosted reviews need their own path handling](source:s2): an export must not name a folder on the machine that wrote it.
groups.summary: `readRepoIdentity` reads the work tree top, `reviewPayload` sends it as `repo.root`, and `exportStaticSite` replaces it with null before it writes any file.

attention.note: `api/review.json` gains `repo.root`: the work tree top under `serve`, null in an export. The exported payload differs from the live one in that field only, and `export.test.ts` checks the rest still match.

groups.title: Agent targets and the shared choice
groups.why: Each app has its own deep link, and [one Claude Code option opens the desktop app](source:s2).
groups.summary: `AGENT_TARGETS` maps each app to a function that builds its link from the prompt and `repo`, and `AgentTargetProvider` in `App.tsx` shares the stored choice with every button; most `App.tsx` lines only move one indent level.

attention.note: Under `serve`, Claude Code gets the work tree as `folder` and Codex as `path`; neither parameter is documented. Claude Desktop's own Finder action uses `claude://code/new?folder=`. An export has no `repo.root`, so both open without a folder.

groups.summary: `AskAgent` replaces `CopyPrompt` at the overview, group and question call sites, and adds a ▾ menu built on the new Radix `dropdown-menu`; a link target renders the button as an `<a href>`.

commits.subject: Claude Code opens in the work tree under serve
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Claude Desktop's Finder action opens claude://code/new?folder=<path>; serve passes repo.root there. Exports have no root, so the link carries the prompt only.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: One Claude Code option: open the desktop app
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
claude://code/new?q= fills the prompt in Claude Desktop. It has no local folder parameter, so local and hosted reviews get the same link. Also strip .GIT case-insensitively and widen the picker tap target on phones.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Dropdown menu is a dev dependency: the UI is bundled
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: Ask AI buttons: pick the agent app and open a draft prompt by deep link
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Each Ask button gets a menu: Copy prompt, Claude Code, Claude Code in VS Code or Cursor, Codex, Cursor, T3 Code. The choice is stored in localStorage and shared by all buttons. Serve passes the work tree path (repo.root) so Claude Code and Codex open in it; an export sets repo.root to null and Claude Code falls back to the origin owner/name.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
